name: skip-sensei
description: AI ad blocker for every site. Skips YouTube video ads and in-video sponsor reads, silences music-streaming ads. Private, on-device.

scripts.build: npm run rulesets && tsc --noEmit && wxt build
scripts.rulesets: node scripts/build-rulesets.mjs && node scripts/build-malware-ruleset.mjs && node scripts/build-cosmetic-filters.mjs && node scripts/build-ruleset-counts.mjs
scripts.package: npm run build && node scripts/build-release-notes.mjs && node scripts/package-zip.mjs
